_about: The demo shop the Core assistant runs as. Shown at the top of Shop profile and kept in shop memory as fixed facts (the advisor cannot change them in the chat). maintenancePresentation is the default for how scheduled maintenance is presented ("prioritized": by severity, the important items first; "all": the full schedule as is); the shop can change it in Shop profile. laborGuidePresentation is the same choice for labor-guide recommendations, the add-on labor that goes with a repair ("prioritized": part-of-the-job and recommended add-ons first, only-if-needed and optional ones offered as conditional; "all": every add-on the labor guide lists, in guide order). packageSeverity is the default level for the severity (high, medium, low) package estimate ("high": only what cannot wait, "medium": plus what protects the vehicle, "low": everything recommended). demoUser is the shop user prefilled on the mock sign-in screen (Core opens on it; Log in just enters the demo). laborRate is the shop's labor rate in dollars an hour, set automatically in shop memory when none is saved (the shop can change it in Shop profile, e.g. "labor rate is 120"). partstechSupplierOrder is the default order of suppliers inside PartsTech (PartsTech is an aggregator; NAPA, O'Reilly and AutoZone are suppliers in it): PartsTech opens on the first one set up on the shop's PartsTech account, with Fastest Delivery on when the parts rule is availability first; the shop can reorder it in Shop profile. partsSupplier is the default parts aggregator (PartsTech; "NAPA" means NAPA's catalog directly, no aggregator), asked in Shop profile; the first entry of partstechSupplierOrder is the default preferred supplier (NAPA).

partsPolicy.label: Availability first, then lowest price
partsPolicy.say: When I pick parts, availability comes first: the part that can be here soonest, then the lowest list price among those.
partsPolicy.why: A part that is not here holds up the bay and the customer's car, so a few dollars of price never beats a part that is in stock.
